summary: Re-tested all iteration_172 findings for CloudIVR Web. Backend: 10/10 pytest pass. CNAM debit is exactly 0.015, measured in walletOf. A 3-number lead check debits 0.045. The 30-day cache makes repeat numbers free and quote counts cached/fresh correctly. recheck:true charges all numbers. scope:contacts checks all 60+ contacts, not just the 50 loaded. listId works. delete-dead deletes only dead contacts. Wallet history rows 'Owner-name lookup · +1…' and 'Lead check · N numbers' show 3-decimal amounts. POST /reviews returns 403 not_eligible for Bob. Frontend checks that passed: Quick IVR owner-name lookup (button only on tap; '+1415555012' shows no button; charged then free; none case; Use as [Name] fills the placeholder). Campaign lead check: price, clean keeps ',Name' suffixes, result stays after clean, cached note, 'Check all again'. Saved-list source. Contacts check plus delete-dead toast. Onboarding: copy, sticky footer on 390x844, Sales+Texting interleave, Change preselects picks, Start reopens after skip, mobile 'For you' group. Setup guide: re-entry via setup-open after skip-all and after Hide; save error toasts. Regression: HeroPhone, reviews section, dark Terms and SIP pages render. Two new issues: one medium (Skip in the 'Change' flow wipes picks), one minor UX.

minor.issue: balance is round2(): sub-cent debits are exact in DB (usdOut += 0.015) but the API/header shows a rounded balance (e.g. 498.385 -> $498.39 or $498.38). Balance deltas of $0.015 cannot be seen via the API. Consider returning 3 decimals or a raw field.
Not atomic for concurrent requests: two parallel lookups of the same uncached number both debit $0.015 (the cache is written after the debit). Low impact.
A 1-number lead check is labelled 'Lead check · 1 numbers' (no plural handling).

ui_bugs.issue: Opening 'Change what I use CloudIVR for' and then clicking 'Skip for now' saves purposes [] and wipes the user's existing picks: Sales+Texting -> [] and the dashboard falls back to dashboard-for-you-start. In the change flow, Skip should close without saving (or be labelled Cancel).

After 'Delete dead contacts (2)' succeeds, the button stays visible with the same count. Clicking it again calls delete-dead and toasts '0 dead contacts deleted'. Hide it or mark it done after cleaning.

If the user edits the leads to a subset of numbers already checked, the old summary is kept (LeadCheck.js line 44 skips the new quote). The counts then still include numbers that were removed, e.g. 2 mobile/1 landline after removing Dan.

issues: The contacts-lead-check card sits flush against the Lists/All-contacts grid below it (about 2px gap). Add mb-4/mb-6 to the card.
'Use as [Name]' toasts '[Name] set to X' even when the script has no [Name] placeholder, so nothing visible changes. Consider hiding the button or inserting [Name].

action_items: Onboarding: when reopened from dashboard-for-you-change, make Skip close the modal without PUT purposes [] (keep existing picks)
Contacts: hide or disable 'Delete dead contacts' after a successful delete-dead
Optional: GET /wallet balance with 3 decimals so sub-cent charges match the history
Optional: pluralise 'Lead check · 1 number'; make CNAM debit+cache idempotent under concurrent taps
critical_code_review_comments: wallet.js balance() uses round2 while debits use round4. The UI header balance drifts by up to half a cent from the true balance.
leads.js /cnam: debit happens before the cache upsert, so concurrent requests double-charge. An upsert-first 'pending' marker or findOneAndUpdate would prevent this.
SetupGuide.js: reopening the wizard (setup-open/setup-redo) does not reset the answer/extras state from the previous run. Harmless but stale.
LeadCheck.js line 44: the skip-requote check only tests that list ⊆ job.results, so the summary is not refiltered to the current list.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all requested flows pass; 1 medium + 2 low UX issues)

seed_data_creation: Temporary contacts, list, phoneLogs and reviews marked _test173 were created and then deleted. Alice was charged about $1.6 in test lookups and checks. Alice's onboarding was reset to not-onboarded, and reset_ui.js was run (Bob not onboarded, Alice setups cleared).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use page.request.post to /api/cloudivr-web/auth/login in browser_automation; it shares cookies with the page. Dismiss cookie-allow-all. Alice shows the onboarding modal unless prefs are set (PUT /prefs/onboarding). Measure exact wallet deltas from Mongo walletOf (usdIn-usdOut), not GET /wallet (round2). The SIP page testid is sip-funnel-page. Quick IVR placeholder inputs only render when the script contains [Name] (quick-script-text / quick-script-ph-Name). The landing reviews-section needs a review with rating >= 4 and text in webReviews. In the mobile More menu, clicking the backdrop with force hits a menu link, so use the More toggle instead.
